shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Da ist er, Papa. Mach ihn fertig.
shots.action: Leon and his father walking toward Erwin's booth in the garage at night
shots.motion: they stride in, Leon points at Erwin

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Hallo, Richard.
shots.action: Erwin stepping out of the booth, calm
shots.motion: he takes off his cap slowly

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Woher kennt der deinen Vornamen?
shots.action: Leon looking between the two, confused

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Leon. Geh zum Auto.
shots.action: the father staring only at Erwin, jaw tight
shots.motion: he does not look at Leon

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Du wolltest ihn doch fertigmachen!
shots.action: Leon protesting

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Zum Auto. Sofort!
shots.action: the father grabbing Leon by the arm and pushing him away
shots.motion: he pushes Leon toward the car

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Zwanzig Jahre. Und dann schickst du mir Bodo.
shots.action: Erwin, sad but calm

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Du hättest nicht zurückkommen sollen.
shots.action: the father, cold, but his eyes wet
shots.motion: his voice is cold but his eyes shine

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Ich war nie weg. Jeden Tag hier unten. Unter deinem Gebäude.
shots.action: the two facing each other under the neon light

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Kein Wort zu meinem Sohn. Hast du verstanden?
shots.action: the father pointing a finger at Erwin

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Du konntest schon immer gut Dinge vergraben.
shots.action: Erwin looking at the father's finger, unimpressed
shots.motion: he looks at the finger, then into his eyes

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: „Erwin und Richard Knolle. Kartoffelacker.“
shots.action: Leon secretly searching his father's desk drawer at night, reading the back of an old photo
shots.motion: he turns the photo over and reads

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Knolle? Wir heißen doch von Trüffel…
shots.action: Leon staring at the photo of the potato man and the little truffle boy
shots.motion: he looks at the photo, confused

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Ramon. Der Alte ist wieder da.
shots.action: the father on the phone, throwing old documents into the fireplace

shots.speaker: RAMON
shots.text: Und der Junge?
shots.action: the chili villain on the phone in a dark car, smiling

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Der Junge stellt Fragen.
shots.action: the father looking at the door nervously

shots.speaker: RAMON
shots.text: Dann sorg dafür, dass er keine Antworten bekommt.
shots.action: Ramon's cold smile in the dark

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Du bist auf einem alten Foto mit meinem Vater. Wer bist du?
shots.action: Leon holding the old photo in front of Erwin at the booth

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Frag ihn.
shots.action: Erwin looking at the photo, a tiny smile
shots.motion: he looks at the photo for a long time

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Ich frag aber dich.
shots.action: Leon serious for the first time

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Ich hab deinem Vater hier das Laufen beigebracht. Auf einem Kartoffelacker.
shots.action: Erwin touching the concrete pillar
shots.motion: he puts his hand on the concrete

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Hier? Das ist ein Parkhaus.
shots.action: Leon looking around the garage

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Jetzt. Der Boden gehört immer noch mir.
shots.action: Erwin calm
shots.motion: he looks down at the floor

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Papa. Ist das dein Vater?
shots.action: Leon holding a half-burnt newspaper from the fireplace with the headline HAUSEINSTURZ, the father turning around
shots.motion: he holds up the burnt paper

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Leg das weg.
shots.action: the father, pale

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Du hast mir gesagt, Opa ist tot!
shots.action: Leon shouting, tears in his eyes

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Für mich war er das.
shots.action: the father turning away to the fire

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Weil er nur eine Kartoffel ist?
shots.action: Leon stepping toward his father

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Weil ich kein Kartoffelbauer sein wollte!
shots.action: the father exploding, slamming his fist on the desk

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Trüffel oder Kartoffel, Richard. Wir kommen alle aus derselben Erde.
shots.action: Erwin standing in the doorway in his attendant uniform, rain on his shoulders
shots.motion: he steps into the warm light

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Und die neun Jahre Gefängnis?
shots.action: Leon looking at Erwin

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Das Haus, das damals eingestürzt ist… hab nicht ich gebaut.
shots.action: Erwin looking at the father
shots.motion: he slowly turns his eyes to Richard

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Papa…?
shots.action: Leon turning to his father in shock

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Ich war jung. Und Ramon hat gesagt, billiger Beton reicht.
shots.action: the father collapsing into his chair

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Und ich hab gesagt, ich war's. Damit mein Sohn eine Zukunft hat.
shots.action: Erwin with wet eyes, still calm
shots.motion: a tear runs down his potato cheek

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Du warst neun Jahre im Gefängnis… für ihn?
shots.action: Leon in tears

shots.speaker: RAMON
shots.text: Wie rührend. Die ganze Familie Knolle an einem Ort.
shots.action: the chili villain in a white suit standing in the doorway behind them, two thugs behind him, car headlights outside
shots.motion: they all turn, headlights flood the room
